page_title: AUX 0-1 PSG | Auxerre v PSG 23/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Clement Akpa (Auxerre) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
90+1' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sekou Mara (Auxerre) is coming onto the pitch as Danny Namaso cannot continue after picking up an injury.
90+1' Christophe Pelissier has decided to substitute Kevin Danois and he is replaced by Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre).
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
89' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
88' Desire Doue (PSG) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
87' Desire Doue (PSG) sends a cross into the box, but Donovan Leon comes off his line to gather the ball.
85' The referee signals a substitution. Romain Faivre (Auxerre) is brought on as a substitute for Lamine Sy.
85' Christophe Pelissier has decided to make a change. Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) replaces Sinaly Diomande.
84' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
82' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ousmane Dembele (PSG).
79' 0 - 1 Bradley Barcola (PSG) received a pass and blasted a powerful shot from just outside the box into the middle of the net.
79' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Kevin Danois (Auxerre) takes it short.
79' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee points to the corner flag and Auxerre will take a corner.
77' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
77' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) attempts to find Lassine Sinayoko, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
76' Desire Doue (PSG) misses a great chance after he found some space in the box! His effort goes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
74' Senny Mayulu (PSG) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Donovan Leon is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
72' Lucas Beraldo (PSG) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Mathieu Vernice ignores the protests.
70' Vitinha (PSG) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

69' What an opportunity! Oussama El Azzouzi (Auxerre) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
67' Rudy Matondo (Auxerre) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
65' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
63' Bradley Barcola (PSG) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
61' Luis Enrique prepares a substitution. Goncalo Ramos is replaced by Ousmane Dembele (PSG).
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Desire Doue (PSG) comes onto the pitch so that Ibrahim Mbaye can be given a rest.
60' The linesman raises his flag. Lamine Sy (Auxerre) is adjudged offside.
60' Lamine Sy (Auxerre) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
59' Lamine Sy (Auxerre) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
58' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
56' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
55' A cross into the box from Vitinha (PSG) is cleared.
54' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
53' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
52' Bradley Barcola (PSG) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
52' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) commits a foul and Mathieu Vernice immediately signals a free kick.
51' Bradley Barcola (PSG) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
48' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
47' A dangerous looking corner kick from Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) is cleared to safety by the defence. The linesman makes the right call and PSG will have a corner.
47' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
46' A pass by Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Naouirou Ahamada (Auxerre) comes off for Rudy Matondo.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) but poses no threat.
45+1' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle and it's Goncalo Ramos (PSG) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
41' Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle as Lamine Sy (Auxerre) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
40' Vitinha (PSG) probably handled the ball.
39' Bradley Barcola (PSG) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

36' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and drills a good shot to the middle of the goal. Donovan Leon shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop the effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
35' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
32' A pass by Bradley Barcola (PSG) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.

30' What a great chance for Goncalo Ramos (PSG). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
29' PSG get a corner.
29' Bradley Barcola (PSG) serves up a nice cross, but Donovan Leon punches the ball away. PSG get a corner.
28' Lamine Sy (Auxerre) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
27' Oussama El Azzouzi (Auxerre) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
24' Senny Mayulu (PSG) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Mathieu Vernice who sees an offensive foul.
23' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) gets to a rebound inside the goalmouth, but even from this distance he misses the target and fails to score. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
23' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
23' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
22' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The referee signals a corner kick to PSG.
21' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
19' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
17' Vitinha (PSG) commits a rough foul. Mathieu Vernice stops the game and makes a call.
14' Oussama El Azzouzi (Auxerre) tries to find Lassine Sinayoko, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
12' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
9' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
8' A great run by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. PSG are awarded a corner kick.
6' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
5' Senny Mayulu (PSG) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Corner kick. PSG will have an opportunity.
3' A pass from Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) is intercepted by Donovan Leon and the move breaks down.
2' Bradley Barcola (PSG) dribbles into the box, but Donovan Leon is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Auxerre will kick-off.
